release_scope.activation_rule: Each disabled claim requires separate archived inputs, rights/authority evidence, validation and an applicable release decision.

participant_policy.agent_panel_role: assess submitted reports and repository evidence; never substitute for factual participant evidence

authority_policy.required_decision: named accountable authority signs a tier-specific decision with scope, exclusions, expiry, rollback and revocation conditions

owner_instruction: Prepare the release packet, but do not promote beta, release candidate or stable-v1 until the named authority signs the applicable decision and every evidence gate passes.
